blurb: MORA Museum of International Art has gone through several transformations. Most recently, the museum changed its name from the Museum of Russian Art to MORA Museum of International Art in order to better reflect the museum’s politics, which always opposed the Russian government and since its founding has served as an intellectual-artistic hub for dissident and human rights activism.
